description: Chief Secretary's Office of Southern Province - Corporative Society percept of the Southern Provincial Council
reasoning: This gazette content primarily concerns the publication of a draft statute (the Cooperative Society Statute) for the Southern Provincial Council. It outlines legal provisions for organizing, registering, supervising, and administering cooperative societies, and explicitly states it will replace previous Cooperative Acts. This falls under "New laws, acts, ordinances, and regulations" and "Statutory instruments and subsidiary legislation," making it a Legal/Regulatory Gazette (Type 5). While a minister is named, the core content is the legal framework, not government personnel changes or detailed portfolio responsibilities.
